title: Sunset Beer Sampling Boat Cruise To Emerald Bay | Public Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: This is more than just a sunset cruise—it is a chance to experience Emerald Bay with a beer tasting built right into the journey. As you cruise across Lake Tahoe at golden hour, guests sample a selection of beers while enjoying the scenery and learning more about what they are tasting along the way. The combination of beautiful views, a relaxed sunset setting, and the added beer sampling experience makes this a fun and memorable twist on a traditional boat tour.
